contradictions.source: شيتانش اى بارد الشعاع لان كرته متبد وفيها الهناءة
contradictions.english: Shitanshu , because its sphere is changing, and in it is tranquility.
contradictions.why: The source says the sphere is 'changing' (muta'abbid/muta'addid) and 'in it is tranquility' (al-hana'a), but the English implies the tranquility is a result of the sphere changing, whereas the source links the cooling effect to the nature of the sphere.
